remove-open-action-from-pdf.title: Remove Open Action from PDF
remove-open-action-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, clear the document's OpenAction to prevent any automatic action on opening, and save the modified file.

set-openaction-goto-page-xyz-destination.title: Set OpenAction to GoTo Page 10 with XYZ Destination
set-openaction-goto-page-xyz-destination.description: Loads a PDF, creates an explicit XYZ destination on page 10, wraps it in a GoToAction, assigns it to the document's OpenAction, and saves the modified file.

set-openaction-goto-page-12.title: Set OpenAction to GoTo Page 12
set-openaction-goto-page-12.description: Loads a PDF, creates a GoToAction with an XYZExplicitDestination pointing to page 12, replaces the document's OpenAction, and saves the result.

set-open-action-goto-page-3.title: Set PDF Open Action to GoTo Page 3 with XYZ Destination
set-open-action-goto-page-3.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating an XYZExplicitDestination for page three, assigning it to a GoToAction, setting the document's OpenAction, and saving the modified file.

set-open-action-navigate-to-page-five.title: Set Open Action to Navigate to Page Five
set-open-action-navigate-to-page-five.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create an XYZ explicit destination for page five, assign it to a GoTo action, set it as the document's open action, and save the file.
